EntityProps.Name: 팝업 공지
EntityProps.Definition: 팝업 공통 설정. WPF 목록 응답의 평면 필드 원본 CONSTRAINT CK_POPUP_DISPLAY_MODE CHECK (DISPLAY_MODE IN ('SEQUENTIAL', 'SIMULTANEOUS')) CONSTRAINT CK_POPUP_SIZE_MODE CHECK (SIZE_MODE IN ('FIXED', 'RATIO', 'FULLSCREEN')) CONSTRAINT CK_POPUP_DISPLAY_ORDER CHECK (DISPLAY_ORDER >= 1) CONSTRAINT CK_POPUP_DISPLAY_PERIOD CHECK (DISPLAY_END_AT >= DISPLAY_START_AT) CONSTRAINT CK_POPUP_REPEAT_INTERVAL CHECK (REPEAT_INTERVAL IS NULL OR REPEAT_INTERVAL >= 1) CONSTRAINT CK_POPUP_REPEAT_DAY_OF_MONTH CHECK (REPEAT_DAY_OF_MONTH IS NULL OR REPEAT_DAY_OF_MONTH BETWEEN 1 AND 31) CONSTRAINT CK_POPUP_HIDE_DAYS CHECK (HIDE_DAYS IS NULL OR HIDE_DAYS >= 1) CONSTRAINT CK_POPUP_COMPLETION_RATIO CHECK (COMPLETION_RATIO IS NULL OR COMPLETION_RATIO BETWEEN 0 AND 1) CONSTRAINT CK_POPUP_PASSING_SCORE CHECK (PASSING_SCORE IS NULL OR PASSING_SCORE >= 0) CONSTRAINT CK_POPUP_WIDTH_RATIO CHECK (WIDTH_RATIO IS NULL OR WIDTH_RATIO > 0) CONSTRAINT CK_POPUP_HEIGHT_RATIO CHECK (HEIGHT_RATIO IS NULL OR HEIGHT_RATIO > 0) CONSTRAINT CK_POPUP_YN_VALUES CHECK (ACTIVE_YN IN ('Y', 'N') AND SHOW_HEADER_YN IN ('Y', 'N') AND SHOW_CLOSE_BUTTON_YN IN ('Y', 'N') AND SHOW_FOOTER_YN IN ('Y', 'N') AND SHOW_DO_NOT_SHOW_AGAIN_YN IN ('Y', 'N') AND ALLOW_CLOSE_BEFORE_COMPLETE_YN IN ('Y', 'N'))
EntityProps.Comment: 팝업 공통 설정. WPF 목록 응답의 평면 필드 원본

EntityProps.Name: 팝업 대상 조건
EntityProps.Definition: 노출 대상 조건. 같은 그룹 내 AND. 유형별 값 컬럼 중 정확히 1개만 사용 CONSTRAINT CK_TARGET_CONDITION_ORDER CHECK (CONDITION_ORDER >= 1) CONSTRAINT CK_TCOND_INCLUDE_CHILD CHECK (INCLUDE_CHILD_YN IN ('Y', 'N')) CONSTRAINT CK_TARGET_CONDITION_OPERATOR CHECK (CONDITION_OPERATOR IN ('=', '!=', '<', '<=', '>', '>=')) CONSTRAINT CK_TARGET_CONDITION_VALUE CHECK ( (CASE WHEN DEPARTMENT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN POSITION_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN EMPLOYEE_NO IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN CONDITION_DATE_VALUE IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 AND (CASE CONDITION_TYPE WHEN 'DEPARTMENT' THEN CASE WHEN DEPARTMENT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHEN 'POSITION' THEN CASE WHEN POSITION_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHEN 'EMPLOYEE' THEN CASE WHEN EMPLOYEE_NO IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHEN 'HIRE_DATE' THEN CASE WHEN CONDITION_DATE_VALUE IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END) = 1 ) CONSTRAINT CK_TCOND_CHILD_DEPARTMENT CHECK (INCLUDE_CHILD_YN = 'N' OR CONDITION_TYPE = 'DEPARTMENT')
EntityProps.Comment: 노출 대상 조건. 같은 그룹 내 AND. 유형별 값 컬럼 중 정확히 1개만 사용

EntityProps.Name: 영상 시청 상태
EntityProps.Definition: 영상 시청 누적. 실시간 진행률 전송을 제거했으므로 팝업 종료 시 1회 MERGE(최대값 유지) CONSTRAINT CK_VIDEO_COMPLETED CHECK (COMPLETED_YN IN ('Y', 'N')) CONSTRAINT CK_VIDEO_DURATION CHECK (TOTAL_DURATION_SECONDS IS NULL OR TOTAL_DURATION_SECONDS >= 0) CONSTRAINT CK_VIDEO_LAST_POSITION CHECK (LAST_POSITION_SECONDS IS NULL OR LAST_POSITION_SECONDS >= 0) CONSTRAINT CK_VIDEO_MAXIMUM_POSITION CHECK (MAXIMUM_POSITION_SECONDS IS NULL OR MAXIMUM_POSITION_SECONDS >= 0) CONSTRAINT CK_VIDEO_WATCHED_SECONDS CHECK (WATCHED_SECONDS IS NULL OR WATCHED_SECONDS >= 0) CONSTRAINT CK_VIDEO_WATCHED_RATIO CHECK (WATCHED_RATIO IS NULL OR WATCHED_RATIO BETWEEN 0 AND 1)
EntityProps.Comment: 영상 시청 누적. 실시간 진행률 전송을 제거했으므로 팝업 종료 시 1회 MERGE(최대값 유지)
